theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks are the highest-ranked (1.333) and one of only four eligible themes, sitting above the 0.59 durability threshold with moderate breadth (0.538) and not crowded (z 0.64). The trend gate validates it as the dominant leadership narrative in an otherwise narrow tape. However, hurst_tag is mean-revert and r10 is negative (-1.4%), so the trend is late and fragile — this reads as durable enough to hold as core exposure within trend-discipline, not to buy aggressively on momentum.
evidence: breadth 0.538 (cohesive, not one-narrative but broad enough)
gate_helps true (trend discipline meaningful in this market)
theses.dissent: Mean-revert hurst plus negative r10 means the momentum could already be rolling over; with only 24% of themes eligible, leadership is thin and a single shakeout could remove the last eligible anchor.

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: China Platform Megacaps rank near the bottom (15 of 17, score -1.255) and are ineligible with the lowest durability_bar in the tape (0.16), zero breadth, and negative crowding_z (-0.74). Under the validated trend-gate discipline, this theme fails the absolute-trend test and should be avoided or de-risked; it is also the only scorable expression (via 3033.HK) of weak China tech appetite right now. This is a risk-control underweight, not a fade/short.
evidence: gate_helps true — trend gate says avoid
theses.dissent: Mean-revert in this tape could give an oversold bounce; if a broad China-policy or liquidity catalyst hits, deeply negative-scoring China tech names may rebound hardest and the trend gate would only delay re-entry, not prevent losses.

falsifier.text: China Platform Megacaps' score improves above -0.6 AND durability_bar rises above 0.35 before the check-by date
